title: Template:Speed
wikitext:
* This skill increases average speed by {{ #expr: {{{1|0}}} / {{{4|0}}} * 0.{{{3|0}}} * 100 round 2 }}...{{ #expr: (( {{{1|0}}} + 12 * ( {{{2|0}}} - {{{1|0}}} ) / 15 ) round 0 ) / {{{4|0}}} * 0.{{{3|0}}} * 100 round 2 }}...{{ #expr: {{{2|0}}} / {{{4|0}}} * 0.{{{3|0}}} * 100 round 2 }}% if used every time it recharges. == Usage == To simplify the insertion of the note in the Notes section on pages of skills that provide a [[speed boost]]. The output of this template will provide green numbers for the average speed increase of [[attribute]] ranks 0, 12, and 15, each separated by ellipses. For speed boost skills which do not follow the 0...12...15 progression, use {{tl|gr2}}. 
{{speed|val_1|val_2|val_3|val_4}}
; val_1 : Speed boost [[duration]] at attribute rank 0 ; val_2 : Speed boost duration at attribute rank 15 ; val_3 : Speed boost % ; val_4 : Skill [[recharge time]] == Example == On [["Charge!"]], {{speed|5|13|33|20}} will parse to: {{speed|5|13|33|20}} [[Category:Formatting templates|Speed]] [[Category:Skill templates|Speed]] [[Category:Skills that cause Increased Movement Speed|*Template]]
